verdict.rationale: Pigment's own Analyst Agent is described as one that "continuously monitors your business", which implies some background agent activity. Scheduled imports show that data loads can run on a schedule without user involvement. However, nothing documents users configuring their own autonomous automations, such as triggers, schedules or agent tasks that act unattended; the Modeler Agent and MCP features are conversational and user-initiated. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, scheduling or triggers for agent tasks, documentation of unattended agent actions, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
